scenes.title: Are You Made of Glass?
scenes.summary: On the 18th-century costume-drama film set of L'Enclos, Julie Gayet (playing an aristocrat) and JoeyStarr (playing a servant) clash over a rough embrace in the bushes; director Samir sees they are five days behind schedule and shouts to call their agents immediately.
scenes.location: Plateau du film en costumes L'Enclos (parc d'un château)

scenes.title: Is That the Tax Woman?
scenes.summary: Morning at Andréa's flat after her night with Colette Brancillon; Gabriel calls about a crisis on the movie set, and as Colette leaves down the stairs, Andréa's neighbor Gabriel spots her on the landing and recognizes the tax inspector.
scenes.location: Appartement d'Andréa et palier de l'immeuble

scenes.title: Happy Birthday, Darling!
scenes.summary: On her 23rd birthday, Camille gets calls from her mother and grandmother on the metro and at ASK, chats with Sofia before Sofia leaves for a two-line role opposite JoeyStarr, and receives a purely business envelope from Mathias without a word about her birthday.
scenes.location: Métro parisien puis réception et couloirs d'ASK

scenes.title: Have You Got Stage Fright?
scenes.summary: On the château film set in the countryside, Sofia gets into her 18th-century servant costume, meets JoeyStarr at the coffee table while Julie waits on set, admits she has stage fright, and rehearses her two lines for him.
scenes.location: Loges et table régie sur le tournage au château

scenes.title: I Can't Act Like This!
scenes.summary: JoeyStarr mangles his 18th-century declaration of forbidden love, Julie storms off into her trailer refusing to come out, and JoeyStarr bangs on her door as Andréa and Gabriel arrive on the château set.
scenes.location: Parc du château et devant la loge de Julie Gayet

scenes.title: That Could Win You a César
scenes.summary: Gabriel advises Julie in her dressing room about the film and its possible career benefits. Outside, JoeyStarr complains to Andrea about Julie's manner of speaking and the difficulty of working with her.
scenes.location: Loge de Julie Gayet et extérieur du château

scenes.title: Like a Magnet
scenes.summary: JoeyStarr complains to a distracted Andrea, who describes her unexpected attraction to Colette. Their conversation gives him another way to think about his own conflict with Julie.
scenes.location: Extérieur du tournage au château

scenes.title: Gabriel Sarda, My Agent!
scenes.summary: At the catering tent, Sofia introduces Gabriel as her agent and tells him about rehearsing with JoeyStarr. Gabriel offers professional encouragement and takes a phone call.
scenes.location: Cantine du tournage dans la cour du château

scenes.title: The Death of Jonathan
scenes.summary: Back at ASK in Paris, Arlette introduces head writer Marie-Sophie Garnier of the daytime soap Que du bonheur to Mathias: fed up with arrogant star Jonathan Joubert rewriting scripts for eight years, Marie-Sophie announces they are killing off his character Ryan with testicular cancer.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias chez ASK

scenes.title: Send Flowers to Marie-Sophie
scenes.summary: At ASK, Camille and the assistants discuss the possible death of Ryan and viewers' attachment to the character. Mathias asks Noémie to send flowers to Marie-Sophie and continues handling demands from his clients.
scenes.location: Open space et couloir des bureaux d'ASK

scenes.title: A Friend in Trouble
scenes.summary: At dinner, JoeyStarr borrows Julie's phone and pretends to receive an urgent call so he can leave. Julie asks for her phone back. Outside, Gabriel and Andrea call after the actors and follow them.
scenes.location: Restaurant puis allée extérieure

scenes.title: Couic! (That's the End of Him!)
scenes.summary: Arlette names the owner of the armchair occupied by her dog, then rejects his flowers and pressure over Jonathan's role. Their argument turns to money, agency shares, dignity and loyalty, before Camille tries to raise another idea.
scenes.location: Bureau d'Arlette chez ASK

scenes.title: The Target Is the Woman at the Hairdresser's
scenes.summary: Noémie shows Mathias a proposed notice about the threatened character and explains the target audience. Mathias rejects the idea. Camille listens from the doorway; she is not the person presenting the notice.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias chez ASK

scenes.title: We Shoot the Love Scene Tomorrow
scenes.summary: The crew must arrange the coming love scene despite the actors' conflict and Julie's injury. Gabriel counsels Julie, who questions why the scene needs a literal intimate performance rather than symbolic images.
scenes.location: Tournage et chambre de Julie à l’hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: You're an Animal, Didier
scenes.summary: In JoeyStarr's room, Andrea encourages him while he worries about the intimate scene, his body and the historical characters. She also comments on his costume. No separate costume assistant or Gabriel speaks this encouragement.
scenes.location: Chambre de JoeyStarr à l’hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: Messages at Reception
scenes.summary: At the hotel reception desk, Gabriel teases Andréa about the receptionist before Andréa checks her messages by phone with Camille and wishes Camillette a happy birthday.
scenes.location: Réception et escalier de l'hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: Surprise in Room Sixteen
scenes.summary: Colette surprises Andrea in her hotel room. After Colette injures herself, Andrea helps her and leaves to join Gabriel for the expected dinner. This learner scene combines the hotel visit and its aftermath.
scenes.location: Chambre16 de l’hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: Someone Important Forgot
scenes.summary: Over dinner, Gabriel wonders whether work has crowded out the agents' personal lives; Andrea decides to return to her room. In Paris, Camille's friends celebrate her birthday in the street, but she is upset that someone important has forgotten the day.
scenes.location: Restaurant de l’hôtel et rue parisienne

scenes.title: CEO of ASK
scenes.summary: In bed at home, Catherine reveals she convinced her father to lend her the money to buy out Samuel's shares at ASK, making Mathias CEO—and they dream together about expanding ASK with writer-director, image-management, and production departments.
scenes.location: Chambre de Mathias et Catherine

scenes.title: She's Not Right for You
scenes.summary: Mathias finds Hippolyte taking wine at home and asks whether he has been with Camille. He warns his son against her and says that she has a boyfriend who visits the agency.
scenes.location: Cuisine de la maison de Mathias et Catherine

scenes.title: Dinner for Two in Room Sixteen
scenes.summary: At reception, Gabriel helps with the new billing software and learns about dinner for two and champagne charged to room16. He then goes to Andrea's door, challenges her explanation and insists on finding out who stayed with her.
scenes.location: Réception de l'hôtel puis chambre 16 d'Andréa

scenes.title: Stop the Car!
scenes.summary: During the drive, Gabriel condemns Andrea's relationship with the tax inspector. After their argument, he stops and Andrea leaves on foot. Meanwhile, Camille shows Mathias the successful petition, then Andrea phones for help from the countryside.
scenes.location: Voiture de Gabriel en campagne et bureau de Mathias chez ASK

scenes.title: Sofia's Scene Is Cut
scenes.summary: Andrea returns to the château on the back of a motorbike and thanks Loïc. The female set assistant announces the afternoon's schedule and the removal of Sofia's scene. Sofia questions the decision and worries that JoeyStarr did not want to work with her.
scenes.location: Cour du château sur le tournage de L'Enclos

scenes.title: An Insect! Fire!
scenes.summary: Samir directs Julie and JoeyStarr's intimate barn scene. The actors struggle with its warmth; an insect and a fire alarm create an unexpected burst of movement and closeness that changes the performance.
scenes.location: Grange du château éclairée aux bougies

scenes.title: Are You Really a Couple?
scenes.summary: Driving back toward Paris, Gabriel and Andréa discuss Colette's cracked rib and Gabriel's pile of restaurant receipts; Andréa admits that she and Colette are truly a couple now and asks Gabriel not to tell anyone at the agency.
scenes.location: Voiture de Gabriel sur la route du retour vers Paris

scenes.title: The Financing Plan and the Agenda
scenes.summary: Catherine and Mathias discuss the arrangements for financing the buyout and their plans for the opera. At ASK, the team wonders why Mathias has called a meeting.
scenes.location: Salon de Mathias et Catherine puis open space d'ASK

scenes.title: ASK Will Not Be Sold
scenes.summary: Mathias announces that he will buy Samuel's shares with financing from his wife. His colleagues question the secrecy and his new control. The argument is interrupted by news that Julie and JoeyStarr are missing, prompting Gabriel to call Julie and Andrea to call Didier.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias puis couloir d'ASK

scenes.title: The Call About Spielberg
scenes.summary: Hervé tricks Julie into answering her phone with a fake voicemail about Steven Spielberg in Paris, allowing Gabriel and Andréa to track Julie and Didier to a luxury spa hotel, stop Didier from attacking a paparazzo, and bring them back to the set for a passionate final take.
scenes.location: Bureaux d'ASK, hôtel-spa de campagne et plateau du château

scenes.title: Comforting Sofia
scenes.summary: At ASK, Jonathan complains about the petition and abuses the assistants until Mathias orders him out. Later Gabriel encourages Sofia about the shoot and her scene's uncertain fate. Sofia proposes a meal and asks if they can begin using tu with one another.
scenes.location: Bureaux et réception d’ASK

scenes.title: I Have Something to Tell You
scenes.summary: Mathias shares birthday champagne with Camille after remembering the day. Catherine and Hippolyte arrive after unanswered calls about the opera, and their suspicions force a request for an explanation. Mathias begins to speak; this learner version does not identify the final line's recipient.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias et couloir d'ASK la nuit
